newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Two Thai banks downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Two Thai banks downgraded.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst John Wadle cut his rating for Thai Farmers Bank Ltd on Monday to market performer from long-term buy.
-- He also reduced his rating for Siam Commercial Bank Plc to market underperformer from market performer.

-- In a report, Wadle also recommended reducing exposure in Bangkok Bank Plc. He kept his rating of market performer for the bank "as we believe that the bank's earnings for 1997 and 1998 face the least risks.
-- "We believe that both BBL and TRB are fully valued, trading on projected 1998 P/Es of 14-16 and trailing price/book ratios of 2.4-2.6."
